about: The places tools/look-bench.mjs pictures, a list a game. ready: true once the game can be driven; prelude: run once it is (a player, the screen quiet); stats: what to say under each picture; each place: run to stand there, then settle (ms) for what streams in. Keep a place where a player stands, facing as they arrive.

wyrd.prelude: if (!WY.D || !WY.D.made || WY.D.name === 'Wren') WY.begin(); WY.menu.hide(); WY.G.say = ''; WY.G.sayT = 0; WY.G.toasts.length = 0;

places.name: Hearthrim: the well and the riftgate
Hearthrim: the houses to the west
The Briarholt's camp
places.run: const n = (WY.W.feats || WY.W.nodes).find(n => n.kind === 'portal' && n.reg === 1); WY.H.x = n.x + 1.5; WY.H.z = n.z + 4; WY.H.yaw = Math.PI;
